source: in-session Claude Code agent (pred-scout-coach) over each artifact role view (kit, build, stages, Eternal, lane augment, matchup verdicts, honesty notes) only; every number ground-checked, failing lines dropped

support.line: Open with Imperial Lash to root and dash onto the enemy carry, then Iron Rose to tank and Royal Flourish to mesmerize while your carry hits the thorned target. With Stonewall and Vainglory done, stay in front and save Queen’s Garden for their group.
support.watchout: Against Riktor, Dekker, Mourn, Narbash or Phase, don't dash in first; wait for their engage, then answer with Queen’s Garden.

offlane.line: Open with Imperial Lash to root and close the gap, then Royal Flourish to mesmerize and Iron Rose to tank the trade while the vine ticks. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, dash onto squishy targets and trap them with Queen’s Garden.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlane matchup leans their way, so farm near your tower and wait for your jungler before committing Imperial Lash.

offlane.line: Poke with Hellfire, then land Web Lash to root and walk in for Crushing Maw up close, where it hits harder and heals you. Once Spectral Schematics and Noxia are done, start fights with Consume to pull them into your bite.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel, Scarlett or Aurora, a missed Web Lash leaves you stranded, so poke from range instead of walking in.

jungle.line: Clear with Crushing Maw to heal, then gank by landing Web Lash first so the root sets up a close-range Crushing Maw. After Spectral Schematics and Noxia, use Consume in tight river fights to pull enemies into your bite.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera or Kwang, don't take early duels; farm the opposite side and fight where your laners can join.

support.line: Land Web Lash on the enemy carry to root them, then step in with Crushing Maw while your carry follows up. Once Stonewall and Vainglory are done, stand in front and use Consume to drag divers off your carry.
support.watchout: Against Riktor, Dekker, Mourn or Narbash, stay behind minions so they can't catch you before you land Web Lash.

midlane.line: Poke with Particle Shredder, then lob Dread Nova to stun and follow with Ether Crystal so the storm stacks Disintegrate. After Spectral Schematics and Timewarp, start Synaptic Obliterator only from a safe spot once their divers have used their engage.
midlane.watchout: Every listed mid matchup leans their way, so play behind minions, farm with Particle Shredder, and wait for your jungler before trading.

support.line: Lob Dread Nova onto enemies who step up, then drop Ether Crystal on your carry to lift them away from divers. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith are done, hold the front and use Synaptic Obliterator after their engage is spent.
support.watchout: Against Riktor, Dekker, Mourn or Narbash, stay out of reach until they use their engage, then answer with Dread Nova.

offlane.line: Push melee laners off you with Ether Crystal, then stun with Dread Nova and chase with Particle Shredder while Disintegrate stacks. Once Spectral Schematics and Timewarp are done, fight from range and finish with Synaptic Obliterator.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel, Scarlett or Aurora, save Ether Crystal to push them off; if you've spent it on damage, back off.

offlane.line: Dash in with Glacial Charge, drop Hoarfrost to root, then Boreal Sweep and basic attacks while they're stuck. Once Spectral Schematics and Wraith Leggings are done, add Cryoseism after the root so the stun lands on someone who can't escape.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, don't start trades with Glacial Charge; keep it to escape and fight only after he wastes his leap.

jungle.line: Gank by dashing in with Glacial Charge, ringing them with Hoarfrost to root, then Boreal Sweep to finish. After Spectral Schematics and Orion, open river fights with Cryoseism on a grouped team and follow with Hoarfrost.
jungle.watchout: Against Kwang, skip the early duel; take camps away from him and gank lanes instead.

support.line: Walk in with Glacial Charge, root the enemy carry with Hoarfrost and slow them with Boreal Sweep so your carry gets free hits. Once Stonewall and Inquisition are done, step in front and drop Cryoseism on whoever dives your carry.
support.watchout: Against Dekker, an even lane, don't spend Glacial Charge first; hold it until her stun is used.

offlane.line: Open with Skull Crusher to leap in and shred their armor, then Dire Howl to slow and buff yourself before Cursed Edge. Once The Perforator and Spear Of Desolation are done, finish low targets with Kingslayer.
offlane.watchout: Most listed offlane matchups lean their way, so trade only after they use their engage, and never count on Berserk to save you.

jungle.line: Gank from behind with Skull Crusher to shred armor, then Dire Howl and Cursed Edge to burst. After The Perforator and Spear Of Desolation, use Kingslayer to catch a fleeing squishy target.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera, Serath, Kwang or Feng Mao, avoid early duels; farm the other side and gank lanes instead.

support.line: Leap onto the enemy carry with Skull Crusher, slow them with Dire Howl, and let your carry follow into the armor shred. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith are done, stand in front and save Kingslayer to launch whoever dives your carry.
support.watchout: Against Riktor, Dekker, Mourn or Narbash, don't leap first into their stun; wait until they commit, then answer.

jungle.line: Mark your gank target with Detection Protocol, follow the trail, then Chrono Swipe in and Primeval Roar to tank and fear them. After Viper and Deathstalker, use Ursine Burst to grab a squishy target and slam them into your team.
jungle.watchout: Most listed jungle matchups lean their way, so avoid one-on-one fights over camps; gank lanes where a teammate can follow.

midlane.line: Hit Eventide then Shadow Slip in so two abilities apply Blood Tithe, then Blade Siphon to heal and re-trigger Shadow Slip to swap back to safety. Once Spectral Schematics and Orion are done, Feast a squishy target to suppress and finish them.
midlane.watchout: Against Gideon, don't dash in while his abilities are ready; wait for him to use them, then go.

offlane.line: Trade with Eventide and Shadow Slip to apply Blood Tithe, then Blade Siphon up close to heal through their return damage. After Spectral Schematics and Orion, Feast a squishy target that rotates into your lane.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, keep Shadow Slip's swap ready to escape; if you've used it to engage, back off instead of extending.

jungle.line: Clear with Blade Siphon to stay healthy, then gank by Shadow Slipping in and following with Eventide to apply Blood Tithe. After Spectral Schematics and Orion, start fights with Feast on the squishiest target and heal with Blade Siphon.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera, an even matchup, don't duel at his camps; fight where your laners can join.

offlane.line: Dash in with Forward Crunch, then weave a basic attack after each ability so Cross Crunch empowers it, using Right Crunch to slow them. Once Viper and Basilisk are done, cast Re-Crunch right after Right Crunch to repeat its slow as they try to escape.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel, Scarlett or Aurora, don't dash in first; trade short and back off before they turn on you.

jungle.line: Gank with Forward Crunch to close the gap and Right Crunch to slow, with a basic attack between abilities for Cross Crunch's empowered hit. After Viper and Basilisk, use Re-Crunch to repeat Right Crunch's slow so they can't run.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera or Kwang, don't duel early; gank lanes and take camps where they aren't.

support.line: Throw Stasis Bomb from long range for a longer stun, then trap them with Containment Fence and slow with Photon Disruptor so your carry follows. Once Stonewall and Inquisition are done, save Ion Strike to stun a group in its center.
support.watchout: Every listed support matchup leans your way, so the plan only breaks if you miss Stasis Bomb first; hold it until they step up.

offlane.line: Poke with Photon Disruptor, then land Stasis Bomb and fence them in with Containment Fence so they can't walk back to their tower. After Spectral Schematics and Orion, finish with Ion Strike in the center for the stun.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, don't fence yourself in with him; keep Rocket Boots and distance, and only poke.

midlane.line: Poke with Photon Disruptor, then land Stasis Bomb and use Containment Fence to cut off their escape before Ion Strike. Once Spectral Schematics and Orion are done, rotate to side lanes with Rocket Boots and set up the same trap.
midlane.watchout: Against Gideon or Iggy & Scorch, don't trade in the open; farm from range and wait for your jungler.

carry.line: Slow them with Old Rusty, silence with Gag Grenade, then turn on Rad Rounds and keep shooting. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, open with Shrapnel Cannon to shred their armor before your attacks, or fire it in the air to escape.
carry.watchout: Against Murdock, don't stand in his range trading shots; farm safely and wait for your support to start the fight.

offlane.line: Poke with Old Rusty so the return hit lands too, then Gag Grenade and Rad Rounds when they step in. After Viper and Deathstalker, hold Shrapnel Cannon to blast off divers in the air and keep shooting.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel, Scarlett or Aurora, they will dive you; stay at range and keep Shrapnel Cannon's air blast for the escape.

carry.line: Poke in ranged stance with Tachyon Lance and Sidewind's empowered Railshot to build Heat, then Zero Shift to melee when they're low. Once Sky Splitter and Viper are done, save Limit Break for when Helios Core overheats in a real fight.
carry.watchout: Against Murdock or Drongo, don't trade in lane; stay ranged behind minions and farm until your support engages.

offlane.line: Trade from ranged stance with Tachyon Lance and Sidewind, then Zero Shift to melee to heal off your damage once they're low. After Sky Splitter and Viper, keep Heat up in fights so Helios Core unlocks Limit Break.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel, Scarlett or Aurora, don't swap to melee early; stay ranged and back off when they engage.

midlane.line: Push the wave in ranged stance with Tachyon Lance, poke with Sidewind's Railshot, and Zero Shift to melee only to finish a low target. Once Sky Splitter and Viper are done, rotate to fights and build Heat so Limit Break is ready.
midlane.watchout: Every listed mid matchup except Argus leans their way, so farm safely in ranged stance and wait for your jungler.

jungle.line: Gank with Reaping Dash, then Hamstring to slow and Safeguard to block their key ability. After Viper and Augmentation, finish low targets with Earth Shatter and use its free recast after an execute to clean up.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera or Kwang, don't duel early; take camps away from them and gank instead.

offlane.line: Trade with Hamstring on a single target for the bonus damage, and pop Safeguard right before their big ability lands. Once Viper and Augmentation are done, Reaping Dash in and finish with Earth Shatter.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel, Scarlett or Aurora, don't dash in first; farm safely until your jungler arrives.

midlane.line: Land Sticky Mine and basic attack to empower it, then send Seek and Destroy and throw Security Gate to root them as they run. Once Orion and Wraith Leggings are done, drop Tesla Dome on a grouped fight and keep them inside with the gate.
midlane.watchout: Against Gideon, don't trade in his range; farm with Seek and Destroy and wait for him to use abilities first.

support.line: Throw Security Gate for your carry to run through, then land Sticky Mine and Seek and Destroy on the enemy carry. Once Stonewall and Raiment of Renewal are done, stand in front and drop Tesla Dome where their team is grouped.
support.watchout: Security Gate is your only root; if you throw it early and miss, back off instead of trading.

offlane.line: Poke with Sticky Mine and basic attack to empower it, then root anyone who chases with Security Gate. After Orion and Wraith Leggings, drop Tesla Dome on whoever dives you and keep hitting inside it.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlane matchup leans your way, so the plan breaks only on a gank; if their jungler is missing, back off.

midlane.line: Slow with Void Breach, drop Cosmic Rift on them, then basic attack for Cosmic Power's tether. Once Wraith Leggings and Orion are done, Torn Space into a grouped fight and drop Black Hole.
midlane.watchout: While you channel Black Hole you stay in place; if their team can still stun you, wait until they're spent.

support.line: Slow the enemy carry with Void Breach so Cosmic Rift lands, and keep Torn Space to open a portal your team can escape through. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith are done, stand in front and Black Hole their team when they group.
support.watchout: If you burn Torn Space to engage, you have no escape; keep it until their stuns are used.

offlane.line: Poke with Void Breach and Cosmic Rift, then basic attack for Cosmic Power's tether. After Wraith Leggings and Orion, rotate to fights with Torn Space and Black Hole a grouped team.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlane matchup leans your way, so the danger is a gank; keep Torn Space ready to escape.

offlane.line: Leap in with Assault The Gates, drop Make Way to shred armor, and land Sacred Oath's empowered attack to slow them. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, use Stone Forged Soul when low to heal and crash back down on them.
offlane.watchout: If Assault The Gates misses a hero, its cooldown isn't cut; back off instead of chasing without your leap.

jungle.line: Clear by hitting camp leaders with Assault The Gates to cut its cooldown, then gank with the same leap and Make Way. After Viper and Basilisk, start fights with Sacred Oath's slow and save Stone Forged Soul for when you're low.
jungle.watchout: Against Kwang, don't duel early; take camps away from him and gank lanes instead.

midlane.line: Leap onto a squishy mid with Assault The Gates, shred with Make Way and slow with Sacred Oath. After Viper and Basilisk, rotate to fights and use Stone Forged Soul to heal and slow anyone near you.
midlane.watchout: Against Gideon or Iggy & Scorch, don't leap in from long range; farm the wave and wait for your jungler.

carry.line: Trade in Sentry Mode with basic attacks and Displacement Blast to burst Pulsefire, holding Energy Shield for their big ability. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, switch to Assault Mode in fights to hit from long range.
carry.watchout: Assault Mode shots drain your mana; when you're low, swap back to Sentry Mode before you commit to a fight.

midlane.line: Poke with Displacement Blast and basic attacks to burst Pulsefire, and use Energy Shield to block their key ability. After Viper and Deathstalker, finish fleeing targets with GTFO.
midlane.watchout: Against Lt. Belica, Gideon or Iggy & Scorch, don't trade early; farm in Sentry Mode and wait for your jungler.

offlane.line: Hold Energy Shield for the melee laner's engage, then fire Displacement Blast in Assault Mode to knock them away and keep shooting. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, finish runners with GTFO.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel or Aurora, back off whenever Energy Shield is down; they will dive you.

offlane.line: Pull them in with Smash 'n Grab, then Double Pain to heal and stack Bloodlust bleeds with basic attacks. Once Viper and Basilisk are done, engage with Stampede and Warlord's Challenge to stun and steal power.
offlane.watchout: Most listed offlane matchups lean their way, so don't extend trades; farm safely and wait for your jungler.

jungle.line: Clear with Double Pain for its heal, then gank with Stampede to drag them toward your laner and Smash 'n Grab to stun. After Viper and Basilisk, use Warlord's Challenge in fights to stun and keep hitting.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera, Serath or Kwang, don't duel early; take camps away from them and gank instead.

support.line: Pull the enemy carry with Smash 'n Grab so your carry can hit them, then Stampede to drag divers away. Once Stonewall and Vainglory are done, stand in front and use Warlord's Challenge to stun anyone near your carry.
support.watchout: Against Riktor, Dekker, Mourn or Narbash, don't channel Smash 'n Grab in the open; wait until they've used their engage.

midlane.line: Lay H11 Cluster Grenades ahead of the wave, lob Land Mine behind your target to knock them into the grenades, then fire a charged R2000 Missile. Once Spirit Of Amir is done, weave a basic attack between casts so Armed Salvo refills your mana.
midlane.watchout: Against Gideon this lane is theirs: stop trading, clear the wave from max range with grenades and save Land Mine to escape his engage.

offlane.line: Seed H11 Cluster Grenades where your opponent farms, hit them with Land Mine, then fire a charged R2000 Missile while they are slowed. After Wraith Leggings lands around minute 22, use Make It Rain to join nearby fights.
offlane.watchout: If a melee bruiser reaches you after Land Mine is spent, you have no escape; back off and wait for it before trading.

support.line: Drop H11 Cluster Grenades on the enemy path, then use Land Mine to knock divers off your carry rather than for damage. As Stonewall and Raiment of Renewal come online, step in front and take hits so your carry keeps shooting.
support.watchout: Land Mine also knocks you back, so a misplaced one throws you away from your carry; land it between the enemy and your carry.

midlane.line: Place Flame Turret near the wave, roll Oil Spill through your opponent, then throw Molotov onto the oil to ignite it. Once Soulbinder is done around minute 15, fight around your turrets and open Inferno only after the oil and fire are on them.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and The Fey win this lane on our read: keep turrets behind your wave and farm safely instead of fighting into them.

offlane.line: Set two Flame Turrets near your tower, slow your opponent with Oil Spill, and ignite it with Molotov while turrets keep shooting. Play for long fights in your turret zone, where the sustain style of Turret Maniac fits; Inferno finishes anyone who stays.
offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane on our read: do not chase him away from your turrets; let him come into them or leave him alone.

support.line: Drop Flame Turret beside your wave, roll Oil Spill at the enemy duo, and ignite it with Molotov to push them off the minions. Once Warden's Faith is done around minute 19, stand in front and absorb the first engage.
support.watchout: Against Dekker, which is theirs on our read, keep turrets behind you and save Inferno's knockback for her engage.

carry.line: Drop Hydroclasm on the enemy, wait for the bubble to grow, then pop it with Brine and land Narcosis on whoever is stuck. Once Wraith Leggings and Oathkeeper are done, open fights with Genesis through walls to knock up their backline.
carry.watchout: Narcosis stops on the first hero it hits, so a frontliner can soak it; reposition for a clean line before throwing it.

midlane.line: Place Hydroclasm in the wave or under your opponent, let it grow, then pop it with Brine for the big hit and follow with Narcosis to hold them. After Oathkeeper around minute 21, use Genesis through walls to start fights in side lanes.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Iggy & Scorch win this lane on our read: stop trading, clear the wave with popped bubbles and save Narcosis for their engage.

support.line: Throw Narcosis to hold a diver while your carry hits them, and drop Hydroclasm between the enemy and your carry to slow anyone walking in. As Stonewall and Vainglory come online, stand in front and soak hits for your carry.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane on our read: if she lands her trap on your carry, do not chase; bubble the path and back off together.

jungle.line: Clear fast, then use Shadow Walk to reach a side lane unseen, open with Crippling Dagger to mark the target, and dash in with Shadow Dance for double damage. Once Spear Of Desolation is done, save Guillotine to finish low-health targets.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win the jungle on our read: avoid fighting them in your camps, invade the opposite side and steal camps instead.

jungle.line: Clear camps to build Rage, then leap onto a wounded target with Ambush, burst with Unleash, and save Invigorate to cleanse their stun. Once Deathstalker is done around minute 16, start fights with Cull while their team is grouped.
jungle.watchout: Kwang wins this matchup on our read: do not duel him early; take camps on the other side.

offlane.line: Trade by leaping in with Ambush only when your opponent is below half health, burst with Unleash, then walk out while your Rage heals you. Once Spear Of Desolation is done around minute 16, start side fights with Cull's stun.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Aurora win this lane on our read: keep Invigorate for their stun and farm under tower instead of trading.

carry.line: Hit your target with basic attacks to stack Vengeance, fire Mercy for extra stacks, then use Dusk to cash the stacks and slow them. Once Deathstalker and Manta Scythe are done, use Shadow Glide to stay at range and save Purge for grouped enemies.
carry.watchout: Purge stops your other abilities except Shadow Glide; if a diver is on you, dash away first and fire Purge only once safe.

midlane.line: Poke with basic attacks and Mercy to stack Vengeance, then trigger Dusk once they have plenty of stacks. Once Manta Scythe lands around minute 21, join side fights and keep Shadow Glide for escape, since it resets on a takedown.
midlane.watchout: Most mages beat you here on our read, including Lt. Belica and Valmont: farm the wave from range and wait for your items before trading.

jungle.line: Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether your target, dash to the Blade with Surge of the Heavens to knock them up, then hit Light of the Heavens. After Prophecy around minute 15, use Fury of the Heavens to teleport in.
jungle.watchout: Players who open with Orion have lost slightly more than they've won; if you fall behind early, switch to the build most players use.

offlane.line: Throw Judgement of the Heavens at your opponent, dash to it with Surge of the Heavens for the knock up, then hit Light of the Heavens with the Blade in hand. After Spectra around minute 21, join fights with Fury of the Heavens.
offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane on our read: do not throw the Blade into him; keep it in hand for the shield and farm.

support.line: Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether whoever dives your carry, then use Light of the Heavens with the Blade in hand for its shield. As Stonewall and Raiment of Renewal come online, use Fury of the Heavens to slow the whole enemy group.
support.watchout: Throwing the Blade leaves you without the shield; if they engage first, keep the Blade in hand and protect your carry instead.

carry.line: Lay Saturation Charge in front of the enemy to slow them, keep firing K-75 Storm Rifle, and drop Rally Point when they jump you to knock them back. Once Spectra is done around minute 15, open fights with Orbital Sanction on their grouped backline.
carry.watchout: Every carry lane is theirs on our read: farm behind your support, cook Frag Order only to escape, and wait for your items.

midlane.line: Keep the wave pushed with Saturation Charge, then fire K-75 Storm Rifle at anyone who walks into the slow. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, open fights with Orbital Sanction and drop Rally Point to keep allies healthy and moving.
midlane.watchout: Every midlane matchup is theirs on our read: clear the wave from range, save Frag Order to launch away, and avoid trades.

offlane.line: Slow your opponent with Saturation Charge, keep shooting K-75 Storm Rifle while they are slowed, and drop Rally Point to knock them off you. Once Deathstalker lands around minute 22, use Orbital Sanction to start side fights.
offlane.watchout: Every offlane matchup is theirs on our read: farm under tower, keep Frag Order to escape, and do not trade until your items are done.

midlane.line: Drop Void Drone near your opponent to drain mana, then follow with Seismic Assault for the stun and Void Bomb on top of them. Once Soulbinder lands around minute 15, finish low-mana targets with Neural Disruptor.
midlane.watchout: Gideon, Iggy & Scorch and The Fey win this lane on our read: play behind your wave and save Seismic Assault for their engage.

support.line: Land Seismic Assault on whoever dives your carry, drop Void Drone in the bush ahead for vision, and add Void Bomb while they are stunned. As Stonewall and Vainglory come online, step in front and take hits for your carry.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane on our read: if your stun misses, there is no second one; pull your carry back and wait.

carry.line: Poke with Void Bomb on the wave, then stun with Seismic Assault and finish with Neural Disruptor once their mana is drained by Void Drone. Once Wraith Leggings lands around minute 22, look for fights where your stun can hit two enemies.
carry.watchout: Your stun is your only protection; if it is spent and a diver reaches you, back off and wait for it before fighting again.

support.line: Throw Maco Sparkle! at the enemy duo and detonate it early on contact for the stun, then lob Maco Gift! onto your carry to heal them. Once Oblivion Crown is done around minute 19, use Maco Strike! to push enemies away from your carry.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker and Mourn win this lane on our read: stay behind your carry, keep Maco Fly! to escape, and heal instead of trading.

midlane.line: Mark your opponent with Mark, slow them with Hive, then pass through them with Swarm to heal off the damage. Once Orion is done around minute 15, finish marked targets with Curse; it removes the mark, so use it as the last hit.
midlane.watchout: Gideon wins this lane on our read: do not use Swarm to go in; save it to escape his engage and farm with Hive.

offlane.line: Mark your opponent with Mark, throw Hive to slow them, then dash through with Swarm to heal off the damage. Once Orion lands around minute 16, use Curse on the marked target to finish trades.
offlane.watchout: Swarm is both your heal and your escape; if you spend it to go in and they survive, back off at once.

support.line: Mark the enemy carry with Mark, slow their duo with Hive, and use Swarm to walk out of trouble while it heals you. Once Noxia and Timewarp are done, save Curse to finish a marked target your carry has damaged.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane on our read: stay behind your carry and use Hive to slow her engage, not to start trades.

support.line: Pull a target in with Abduct, then channel Beguile while they are close to mesmerize them, and cast Contagion to heal yourself and your carry. Once Noxia and Wraith Leggings are done, use Eclipse to blind the enemy team before a fight.
support.watchout: Riktor and Dekker win this lane on our read: do not channel Abduct in the open against them; stay near your carry and heal.

offlane.line: Pull your opponent in with Abduct, channel Beguile to mesmerize them, and fight with Contagion running to heal through the trade. Once Oathkeeper lands around minute 16, use Eclipse to blind the enemy team before side fights.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett and Aurora win this lane on our read: farm safely and use Beguile only to stop their engage.

jungle.line: Clear camps with Contagion running, then pull a lane target with Abduct and channel Beguile to mesmerize them for your laner. Once Oathkeeper is done around minute 16, use Eclipse to blind the enemy team before contesting objectives.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Serath and Kwang win the jungle on our read: do not duel them; pick fights alongside a laner instead.

carry.line: Place Static Trap where enemies will walk, shoot them while they are rooted, and use Buckshot to push away anyone who dives you. Once Deathstalker and Manta Scythe are done, use Hot Pursuit in fights and fire Long Arm of the Law at fleeing targets.
carry.watchout: Players who open with Viper have lost more often, so if lane goes badly, switch to the build most carries use.

offlane.line: Place Static Trap in the bushes near your lane, shoot your opponent while rooted, and use Buckshot to knock them back if they close in. Once Manta Scythe is done around minute 21, help side lanes with Long Arm of the Law.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Aurora win this lane on our read: play behind your traps and do not trade until your items are done.

midlane.line: Lay Static Trap in front of the wave, punish anyone rooted with basic attacks, and keep Buckshot to push divers off you. Once Manta Scythe lands around minute 21, snipe low-health enemies elsewhere with Long Arm of the Law.
midlane.watchout: Most mages win this lane on our read: farm behind your traps and skip trades until your items are done.

support.line: Lay Consecrated Ground under your carry before a trade, shield them with Alacrity, and charge Serenity to slow the enemy. Once Oblivion Crown and Lunaria are done, use Reversal Of Fortune to fly to a teammate in trouble anywhere on the map.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker and Mourn win this lane on our read: stay behind your carry and keep Alacrity for their engage.

support.line: Stun a diver with Thunk, keep Song Of My People playing, and trigger March! to speed your team in or out of a fight. Once Wraith Leggings and Oblivion Crown are done, channel Crash Bang Boom! in the middle of grouped enemies.
support.watchout: Riktor and Dekker win this lane on our read: do not walk forward to Thunk them; wait for them to come to you.

midlane.line: Throw L.I.N.X through the wave and your opponent, land Data Burst to slow them, and dash with Erase Vector for an exploding Jolt. Once Oathkeeper is done around minute 16, use Final Thread to finish low-health targets.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon and Iggy & Scorch win this lane on our read: farm from range and keep Erase Vector to escape.

support.line: Slow the enemy duo with Data Burst, pass L.I.N.X through them for damage, and dash with Erase Vector to stay safe. Once Warden's Faith is done around minute 19, stand in front of your carry and save your overclocked Data Burst for divers.
support.watchout: Riktor and Dekker win this lane on our read: stay behind your carry and keep Erase Vector to dodge their engage.

support.line: Link your carry with Telekinetic Link, then use Psychic Flare to blind enemies facing you and Energy Lance to root a diver. Once Stonewall and Vainglory are done, open fights with Hyperflux so you and your carry both hit harder and faster.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker and Mourn win this lane on our read: keep the link short and pull your carry back if they engage.

jungle.line: Clear camps fast, then carry Boulder Throw into a lane, stun your target, and follow with Pounce and Rumble to slow them. Once Spear Of Desolation is done around minute 15, use Behemoth to stay alive in fights.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Kwang and Feng Mao win the jungle on our read: avoid duels with them and invade the opposite side instead.

support.line: Stun a target with Boulder Throw, then Pounce in and use Rumble to slow them so your carry can follow up. Once Inquisition and Stonewall are done, use Behemoth to stand in front of your team and soak hits.
support.watchout: Riktor and Dekker win this lane on our read: do not jump in first; let them engage and answer with Boulder Throw.

midlane.line: Mesmerize your opponent with Stupor, throw Mortal Coil on them to pull and damage them, and fire Soulfire while they are stuck. Once Oathkeeper is done around minute 16, collect Essence from fights to grow every ability.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon, Iggy & Scorch and The Fey win this lane on our read: farm safely and save Stupor for their engage.

support.line: Mesmerize a diver with Stupor, then throw Mortal Coil to hold them while your carry hits them. As Stonewall and Warden's Faith come online, stand in front of your carry and soak hits.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash win this lane on our read: stay behind your carry and use Stupor only on their engage.

offlane.line: Mesmerize your opponent with Stupor, throw Mortal Coil to pull them, and fire Soulfire while they are stuck. Once Oathkeeper lands around minute 16, use Abyssal Rift to teleport into side fights.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Aurora win this lane on our read: farm safely and save Stupor to stop their engage.

carry.line: Mark your target with Scar, then fire Obliterate so its missiles chase them, and finish with Fate's final round. Once Deathstalker and Manta Scythe are done, open duels with Reckoning to pull a carry away from their team.
carry.watchout: Most carry lanes are theirs on our read: farm behind your support and save Reckoning until your items are done.

midlane.line: Mark your opponent with Scar, then fire Obliterate so its missiles chase them, and land Fate's final round for bonus damage. Once Manta Scythe lands around minute 21, use Reckoning to isolate a target in side fights.
midlane.watchout: Every midlane matchup is theirs on our read: farm from range, reload with Hellfire Rounds and do not start trades early.

offlane.line: Open with Scar on the enemy laner, then use basic attacks and Obliterate so each hit pops a Marked stack until the root lands. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, stay in trades longer and land Fate's final round for Hellfire Rounds' bonus damage.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlaner wins this lane; farm under tower, skip long trades, and save Reckoning for isolating a squishy target later.

support.line: Land Riplash to pull a target into your carry, then Shock Therapy to silence them and Electrocute for the shield while you trade. As Stonewall and Vainglory come online, walk in front and hold Skewer until several enemies line up.
support.watchout: Against Dekker a missed Riplash leaves you stranded; stay behind your carry and wait for her to commit before throwing the hook.

jungle.line: Clear camps with Electrocute running, then gank by landing Riplash from fog and following with Shock Therapy so the target cannot escape. Once Spectra and Prophecy are done, stay in fights longer and finish with Skewer when enemies clump up.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang beat you in a straight duel; skip contested invades against them and gank lanes instead.

offlane.line: Trade with Electrocute up so its shield soaks their hits, then Riplash and Shock Therapy to drag the laner into your minions. After Spectra and Prophecy, take longer fights and save Skewer to lock down the enemy carry.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Aurora win this lane; skip long trades, farm the wave, and wait for your jungler before pulling.

offlane.line: Dash through the laner with First Intent for the shield, then land Ashen Vow's outer edge to empower Cindara. Once Augmentation and Viper are done, open with Swan Song on a squishy target and finish with Minueta's stabs.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Aurora win this lane; when First Intent is down, back off instead of trading without your shield.

jungle.line: Clear with Ashen Vow's outer edge on camp leaders to refill Energy, then gank by landing Swan Song first and following with First Intent and Minueta. With Augmentation and Viper done, hunt squishy carries instead of tanks.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang beat you in duels; don't contest their camps alone, and never spend Swan Song on a full-health tank.

jungle.line: Dive in with Ascend, then clap Chastise to slow the target and chase with Heaven's Fury. Once Viper and Spear Of Desolation are done, pop Heresy in fights and grab the visage Fallen Grace leaves to keep chaining takedowns.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win straight duels; avoid fighting them in their jungle and look for ganks on lanes instead.

offlane.line: Trade with Chastise into a basic attack, then back off before the laner answers, keeping Ascend to escape or join a gank. Once Viper and Spear Of Desolation are done, dive squishy targets with Heaven's Fury and Heresy.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett and Aurora all win this lane; farm safely and wait for your jungler instead of forcing trades.

offlane.line: Land Siphon on the enemy laner every trade to steal health, and finish minions with abilities to collect Souls. Once Spectral Schematics and Timewarp are done, open fights with Phantom Rush's fear into Subjugate, then Colossal Blow.
offlane.watchout: Greystone and Aurora win this lane; stop trading, last-hit minions with abilities for Souls, and wait for team fights.

jungle.line: Finish monsters with abilities to stack Souls fast, then gank with Phantom Rush into Subjugate. Once Spectral Schematics and Timewarp are done, use Colossal Blow to knock enemies toward your team rather than away from it.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win duels against you; skip their jungle and spend early minutes stacking Souls on your own camps.

offlane.line: Poke with Line Tempo, then Rushing Beat in, cast Circle Rhythm for the shield and dash out with the second charge. Every ability hit builds Track, so once Spectral Schematics and Timewarp are done, cast All-Kill! as soon as it is ready.
offlane.watchout: Greystone and Steel win this lane; if both Rushing Beat charges are spent, back off before they lock you down.

jungle.line: Gank with Rushing Beat, then Circle Rhythm and Line Tempo to stack Track while the wolves shield you. Once Spectral Schematics and Timewarp are done, finish skirmishes with All-Kill! on every marked enemy.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win duels; don't invade them, and always keep one Rushing Beat charge saved to escape.

midlane.line: Poke the laner with Line Tempo and Biting Melody basic attacks, then all-in with Rushing Beat into Circle Rhythm. After Spectral Schematics and Timewarp, roam to side lanes and cast All-Kill! once Track is full.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Iggy & Scorch win this lane; farm the wave with Line Tempo and skip trades until your jungler arrives.

carry.line: Poke with Plasma Grenade and Starfire, then commit with Hypercharge only when the target is in range and slowed. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, hover with Air Assault for extra range and finish low targets with Atomiser.
carry.watchout: Sparrow, TwinBlast, Murdock and Drongo win this lane; farm behind your support and save Air Assault to dodge their engage.

midlane.line: Clear waves with Plasma Grenade and basic attacks, and use Hypercharge only when you are sure of a kill. After Viper and Deathstalker, fight from range with Air Assault and finish fleeing targets with Atomiser.
midlane.watchout: Every listed mid laner wins this lane; farm safely, shove with Plasma Grenade, and wait for your jungler before trading.

carry.line: Stack Relentless with basic attacks, then fire Piercing Shot through the laner, using Hail of Arrows to slow anyone walking up. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, reposition with Heightened Senses and fire Inner Fire into grouped enemies.
carry.watchout: TwinBlast, Murdock, Drongo and Eden win this lane; farm safely and use Heightened Senses to escape, not to engage.

offlane.line: Poke with Piercing Shot and basic attacks from max range, and drop Hail of Arrows on the wave to farm safely. After Viper and Deathstalker, stay at the back of fights and fire Inner Fire into grouped enemies.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlaner wins this lane; hug your tower, keep Heightened Senses for escapes, and call your jungler early.

midlane.line: Clear waves with Hail of Arrows and poke with Piercing Shot, keeping your distance from the laner. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, stack Relentless in fights and fire Inner Fire from behind your frontline.
midlane.watchout: Most listed mid laners win this lane; farm from range and save Heightened Senses for escapes rather than chasing.

offlane.line: Open with Bull Rush to knock the laner around, then Shield Bash to stun and keep trading behind Cybernetic Shell. Once Spectral Schematics and Oathkeeper are done, lead team fights with Shield Slam onto grouped enemies.
offlane.watchout: Greystone and Aurora win this lane; farm safely and wait for a gank before spending Bull Rush.

support.line: Block enemy poke with Force Shield, then step in with Bull Rush and Shield Bash when your carry can follow. As Stonewall and Vainglory come online, start fights with Shield Slam onto the enemy carry and stand in front of your team.
support.watchout: Dekker beats you in lane; hold Force Shield for her poke and engage only when your carry is ready to follow.

jungle.line: Clear with Bull Rush, which stuns monsters, then gank from the side with Bull Rush into Shield Bash's stun. After Spectral Schematics and Oathkeeper, start team fights with Shield Slam on the enemy backline.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang beat you in duels; avoid their jungle and spend your time ganking lanes instead.

offlane.line: Trade with Highland Hurl to slow and cut armor, then Ruthless Assault, and once Hersir is full use the empowered Highland Hurl to root. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, dive with Unstoppable Force to cleanse and switch off enemy towers.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett and Aurora win this lane; trade only with empowered abilities and farm near your tower otherwise.

jungle.line: Gank with Wild Rush from fog, then Highland Hurl and Ruthless Assault to build Hersir for an empowered root. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, use Unstoppable Force to dive towers and cleanse enemy stuns.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win duels; skip invades against them and save Unstoppable Force for team fights, not camp fights.

midlane.line: Poke with Harvest Nettles on the same target to stack its damage, and drop Untamed Growth on the wave. Once Spectral Schematics and Wraith Leggings are done, fight around Bramble Patch and pull grouped enemies together with Fly Trap.
midlane.watchout: Gideon wins this lane; stay out of his range, farm with Untamed Growth, and wait for your jungler.

support.line: Poke with Harvest Nettles and lay Bramble Patch in front of your carry so enemies slow while allies speed up. As Stonewall and Warden's Faith come online, hold Fly Trap for when the enemy jumps onto your carry.
support.watchout: Dekker is an even lane; don't waste Fly Trap on a lone poking target, save it for their real engage.

carry.line: Weave an ability between basic attacks so Gunslinger fires the triple shot, opening trades with Vortex Grenade. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, Vaporize through groups and Ventilate the closest target, using Rocket Dash to stay out of reach.
carry.watchout: Murdock and Drongo win this lane; farm with Vaporize and save Rocket Dash to escape their engage.

offlane.line: Poke with Vortex Grenade into a Gunslinger triple shot, then step back before melee laners close the gap. After Viper and Deathstalker, stay behind your team and Ventilate whoever dives you.
offlane.watchout: Most listed offlaners win this lane; hug tower, keep Rocket Dash for escapes, and ask your jungler for help early.

midlane.line: Clear waves with Vaporize and poke with Vortex Grenade into Gunslinger's triple shot, keeping Rocket Dash ready. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, roam to fights and Ventilate from behind your frontline.
midlane.watchout: Every listed mid laner wins this lane; farm from range, skip trades, and wait for your jungler.

midlane.line: Bind the laner with Arterial Grip, then Bloodbound and Crimson Sigil basic attacks so Lilith strikes them through Hemophagia. Once Spectral Schematics and Wraith Leggings are done, stay in longer fights and use Exsanguinate to heal off enemy heroes.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon and Iggy & Scorch win this lane; any stun breaks Arterial Grip, so bind only after theirs is used.

offlane.line: Grip the laner with Arterial Grip so they are grounded, then Rupture and Bloodbound while Lilith strikes. After Spectral Schematics and Wraith Leggings, lean on Exsanguinate to heal through longer trades.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Aurora win this lane; breaking line of sight ends your bind, so farm safely until your jungler comes.

carry.line: Mark the target with Peekaboo!, then fire Knock, Knock! for bonus damage and a faster cooldown. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done, use Back It Up! to send a diving enemy back out of the fight.
carry.watchout: Sparrow, TwinBlast, Murdock and Drongo win this lane; farm with Knock, Knock! from range and keep Surprise, Surprise! to escape.

midlane.line: Clear with Knock, Knock! on minions and poke the laner after marking them with Peekaboo!. After Viper and Deathstalker, use your Sonar Drone to find picks and Back It Up! to undo an enemy's escape.
midlane.watchout: Most listed mid laners win this lane; farm from range, hold Surprise, Surprise! for escapes, and skip all-ins.

support.line: Use your Sonar Drone to reveal the enemy duo, and slow divers with Peekaboo! so your carry can follow up. As Stonewall and Warden's Faith come online, use Back It Up! to undo an enemy engage onto your carry.
support.watchout: Every listed support beats you in lane; play safe, keep vision up, and save Back It Up! for their engage.

jungle.line: Gank in Spirit stance with Windsurge, then swap stance with 84000 Hairs and Pole Vault in for attack speed while clones spawn. Once Viper and Solaris are done, start fights with High Impact from high ground.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Serath, Kwang and Feng Mao win duels; don't contest their camps, use Cloudwalker to roam and gank instead.

offlane.line: Trade in Body stance with Pole Vault for attack speed, and switch to Spirit for Cyclebreaker's damage reduction and stun when they hit back. After Viper and Solaris, use clones from 84000 Hairs to keep pressure in long fights.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlaner wins this lane; farm safely, use Cyclebreaker to survive ganks, and wait for your jungler.

jungle.line: Gank with Lash Kick to slow the target, then keep basic attacking so Windburn's third hit and Rising Storm stack up. Once Solaris and Viper are done, drop Quelling Gale to stop enemy projectiles while you trade.
jungle.watchout: Every listed jungler beats you in duels; don't invade, clear your own camps, and fight only beside a teammate.

offlane.line: Close in with Lash Kick, then chain basic attacks for Windburn's bonus hit, using Backlash to reflect incoming projectiles. Once Solaris and Viper are done, take longer trades inside Quelling Gale.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlaner wins this lane; farm safely, save Lash Kick to escape, and wait for your jungler.

jungle.line: Hit the target with Anima Burst or Whispering Echoes to apply Soul Rip, then Severance into them to reset its cooldown and dash again. Once Viper and Solaris are done, use Soulstorm to pull grouped enemies in.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Serath, Kwang and Feng Mao win duels; don't invade them, and commit Severance only on targets with Soul Rip.

offlane.line: Poke with Whispering Echoes, then Severance onto the marked laner and spin Anima Burst to heal back. After Viper and Solaris, chain Severance resets in fights and finish with Soulstorm.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett and Aurora win this lane; trade only when Anima Burst is ready to heal you.

offlane.line: Throw Spear of Nyr to poke, then Evade in and trade with basic attacks while Barricade blocks their answer. Once Viper and Spear Of Desolation are done, leap onto a low target with Coliseum to finish them.
offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane; hold Barricade for his engage and trade only after he has used it.

jungle.line: Gank by closing in with Evade, swing Barricade to stun, then finish fleeing targets with Spear of Nyr. Once Viper and Spear Of Desolation are done, invade and duel, since most listed junglers lose to you.
jungle.watchout: Kwang is an even duel; don't take long fights with him unless your laner is nearby.

support.line: Throw Spear of Nyr to poke, and step in front of your carry with Barricade to block damage, then stun the diver. As Stonewall and Inquisition come online, start fights with Coliseum on the enemy carry.
support.watchout: Dekker beats you in lane; save Barricade for her engage instead of spending it to trade.

support.line: Poke with Ricochet and Bad Medicine to trigger Triage Protocol, then Infuse your carry with the boosted healing. As Oblivion Crown and Lifecore come online, hold Neural Regenesis for the ally the enemy dives first.
support.watchout: Every listed support beats you in lane; stay behind your carry and save Ricochet's stun for their engage.

offlane.line: Trade with Ricochet's stun into Bad Medicine, then step back while your abilities recharge. Once Spectral Schematics and Oathkeeper are done, cast Neural Regenesis on yourself before committing to a dive.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlaner wins this lane; farm with Bad Medicine from range and call your jungler before trading.

midlane.line: Clear waves with Bad Medicine and stun the laner with Ricochet when it can bounce through them. After Spectral Schematics and Oathkeeper, roam to fights and cast Neural Regenesis on the ally the enemy focuses.
midlane.watchout: Every listed mid laner wins this lane; farm safely from range and skip trades until your jungler arrives.
